account.title: Your account
account.pitchTitle: Keep your places on every phone
account.pitchBody: Sign in to back up the places you check and save, and to carry Pro to a new phone. Optional: everything works without it.
account.signedOut: Signed out. Your places stay on this phone.
account.name: Name
account.deleteBody: Your account and every place backed up to it are deleted now and can't be recovered. Places on this phone stay until you delete them. An active subscription must be cancelled in your store account.
signin.title: Sign in to Temen
signin.body: Back up your places and take Pro with you. We never post anything or share your email.
signin.badEmail: That doesn't look like an email address.
signin.codeSent: We sent a code to {email}. It may take a minute; check spam too.
signin.fine: By signing in you agree to the Terms and the Privacy policy (Account → Help & legal).
signin.offTitle: Accounts aren't on in this build
signin.offBody: Everything else works: your places stay on this phone.
about.title: About Temen
about.sourcesLede: Every reading names its dataset, years and resolution. All of these are open and used under their licences.
about.name: Temen is Sumerian for "foundation".
paywall.noStoreBody: Purchases aren't available in this build yet. Everything free keeps working.
paywall.perkAll: Every place in full: all five readings, every question and the PDF report
paywall.perkCompare: Compare up to five places side by side
paywall.perkWatch: Monsoon Watch: heavy-rain alerts for saved places
paywall.perkOffline: Saved places open offline and back up to your account
